summary: Strengthen board cyber oversight with risk appetite, ransomware and supplier-risk simulations. Explore the course and practical board outputs.
lede: Cybersecurity governance training helps board members, non-executive directors, and senior executives make informed decisions about material cyber risk. It develops practical skills in setting risk appetite, assessing ransomware and supplier exposure, challenging security investment cases, and reviewing cyber evidence and incident reporting through board-focused exercises and a tabletop simulation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for leaders who set cyber oversight expectations, review security investment, or make decisions during material incidents. It is relevant to board-level and executive roles that need to challenge cyber reporting without taking on technical operations.
prerequisites: Suitable for people with experience in board oversight, executive decision-making, risk management, or cyber governance. No coding or hands-on security-tool administration is required. Familiarity with organizational risk reporting will help you engage with the case exercises.
